name: ondrhn
description: Plugins by ondrhn: tools that read a project's rules before an agent acts on it.

plugins.name: contrib-policy
plugins.description: Reads a project's contribution rules before a pull request goes out and answers GO / GO-DECLARE / STOP with the sentence that decides it. Installing this plugin also turns on a PreToolUse gate: gh pr create, glab mr create and the pull request API are denied until scripts/policy_scan.sh has been run for that project with --receipt and the receipt says GO.
